name: Hestia Control Panel (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: GPL-3.0 open-source Linux web hosting control panel to manage domains, Apache/Nginx, mail, DNS and databases; no vendor software subscription or control-panel usage quota.
watch_out: Requires a self-operated supported Debian/Ubuntu server with root access, bandwidth, domains, backups and security maintenance; VPS and infrastructure are not included. GPLv3 obligations apply. HestiaCP name/logo have trademark restrictions on resale or rebranding; this is not a free hosted website plan.
